<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { ActionSet } from "./cta-actions.types";

  export type CtaActionsProps = {
    id: string;
    actions: ActionSet;
    center?: boolean;
  };

<script lang="ts">
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Form from "../primitives/form/form.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Input from "../primitives/input/input.svelte";
  import Label from "../primitives/label/label.svelte";
  import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let { id, actions, center = false }: CtaActionsProps = $props();
</script>

{#if (actions.mode === "form")}
  <Form method="dialog" class={cn("w-full max-w-md", (center ? "mx-auto" : ""))} data-testid="email-form">
    <Label for={tpl("{0}-email", id)} class="sr-only">
      {actions.emailLabel}
    </Label>
    <Group gap="2" align="start" class="w-full flex-wrap">
      <Input type="email" name="email" class="min-w-0 flex-1" id={tpl("{0}-email", id)} data-testid="field" />
      <Button variant="default" size="default" type="submit" data-testid="submit">
        {actions.cta}
      </Button>
    </Group>
  </Form>
{:else}
  <ActionGroup
    primary={actions.cta}
    primaryHref={actions.href}
    secondary={((actions.mode === "two") ? actions.secondary : undefined)}
    secondaryHref={actions.secondaryHref}
    align={(center ? "center" : "start")}
  />
{/if}
